items.title: PEP 841: Adding Frozen Syntax to Optimize Immutable Types
items.content_text: This PEP proposes frozen display syntax: f{1, 2, 3} evaluates to a frozenset, and f{'a': 1} evaluates to a frozendict. Because immutability is guaranteed by the syntax itself rather than inferred from usage, the compiler can treat frozen displays as first-class citizens of its optimization pipeline: constant displays are folded into a single LOAD_CONST with an exact result type at compile time and cached in .pyc files.
